cells.reason: Paraguay Decree 1335/2019, the national incorporation of MERCOSUR GMC Res. 12/11, carries the arsenic-table row 'cephalopod molluscs' 1 mg/kg on 'product as offered to the consumer'; the page records it as total arsenic (the table says arsenic without inorganic speciation), a content ML that covers the product form and has been in force since the decree of 20 February 2019. Equal 1000 ug/kg total-arsenic rows cover the same product in AU-NZ Schedule 19 ('molluscs'), Singapore ('fish, crustaceans and molluscs'), MERCOSUR 12/11 itself and Uruguay's general solid-food limit, so nothing non-gated on the same basis is stricter; Guyana's 200 ppb row is quarantined and Israel FCS 2016 'seafood' 1000 is superseded. The EU 2025/1891 cephalopod value of 0.050 mg/kg is inorganic arsenic, a different analyte, and is not a same-analyte candidate.
